<mxCell id="lniYqdlDWRo3v2JFKLLH-56" value="<h1>KV vs SQL mode</h1><p>The prototype comes in two operation modes: KV-mode, and SQL-mode.<br>KV-mode is a backwards compatible code path that implements Basil. In KV-mode clients only issue Point Queries (i.e. Get/Put)<br>SQL-mode allows to process SQL statements instead.&nbsp;<span style="background-color: initial;">This is the default mode of Pesto. Clients issue either Query (e.g. "SELECT ...") or Write (e.g. "INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE") statements.</span></p>" style="text;html=1;strokeColor=none;fillColor=none;spacing=5;spacingTop=-20;whiteSpace=wrap;overflow=hidden;rounded=0;" vertex="1" parent="1"> <mxGeometry x="-30" y="710" width="1030" height="120" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="lniYqdlDWRo3v2JFKLLH-58" value="The client manages transactions and delegates execution of queries to shard clients. The client is unaware of replication within shards." style="text;html=1;strokeColor=none;fillColor=none;align=center;verticalAlign=middle;whiteSpace=wrap;rounded=0;" vertex="1" parent="1"> <mxGeometry x="-50" y="170" width="160" height="60" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="lniYqdlDWRo3v2JFKLLH-59" value="The shard client is responsible for managing the Pesto interface to a replicated set of div.p:
The prototype comes in two operation modes: KV-mode, and SQL-mode.
KV-mode is a backwards compatible code path that implements Basil. In KV-mode clients only issue Point Queries (i.e. Get/Put)
SQL-mode allows to process SQL statements instead. This is the default mode of Pesto. Clients issue either Query (e.g. "SELECT ...") or Write (e.g. "INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE") statements.

The Peloton Engine is responsible for maintaining a set multi-versioned rows for each table, and executing SQL statements against them.
This is a "hacked" version of Peloton: it does not perform CC, it is merely a data store.

The KV-Store contains the version information required to perform concurrency control.
In SQL mode it it contains only versions.
In the KV mode (Basil) it also contains data (e.g. serialized table rows)
